in_sanskrit.name: हिमांग्शु
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: हिमः (Hima) - Sun God + अंग् (Ang) - Body + शु (Shu) - Lord; The Lord of the Sun's Body

in_marathi.name: Himangshu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Himangshu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'himan' (moon) and 'angshu' (radiant), this name refers to one who is moon-like in appearance or demeanor. In Hindu mythology, the moon is often associated with wisdom, calmness, and nourishment. This name carries the blessings of the celestial body and imparts a sense of tranquility and intelligence.
